title: Provider information
description: EXOBASIS provider identity, contact and legal particulars.
intro: EXOBASIS is the brand for arranging a prepared base abroad. For legal notices and contractual questions, the identity of the provider responsible for the actual assignment is what matters.

sections.title: Responsible provider
sections.body:
EXOBASIS is a brand for arranging international preparations. The brand alone is not a contracting party or a legal form. What matters is the legal entity named in the actual offer, accepting the assignment and issuing the invoice.

A reliable provider identification requires that entity’s full legal name, legal form and authorised representative. An operational base in a country does not establish that identity.
reviewRequirements: Full legal name and legal form
Confirmation of the entity entering contracts and issuing invoices

sections.title: Address for legal correspondence
sections.body: The operational base in the Dominican Republic describes where the project works. It is not automatically the address for legal notices. A complete address for service, including locality and country, must belong to the responsible provider and be used with authority. A specialist’s address or a post box does not replace it without a relevant legal basis.
reviewRequirements: Verified address for legal notices, including country
Confirmation that this address may be used

sections.title: Direct contact
sections.body:
For organisational questions, use Private enquiry. Asking a legal question does not require an orientation call or a purchase. A public, copyable way to contact the responsible provider directly must also be available independently of the enquiry form.

The Service and contract terms explain the contractual steps. Information about personal data belongs in the Privacy notice.
reviewRequirements: Any further required direct contact channel
A successful test of the chosen enquiry route

sections.title: Registration and competent authorities
sections.body:
Registration, tax and professional details, where applicable, must refer to the actual legal provider. A separate specialist’s registration or licence is not the EXOBASIS provider’s registration. Only verified, applicable authorities and identifiers for that provider can be published here.

For a specific question about the provider, use Private enquiry. An enquiry cannot replace a required legal particular.
reviewRequirements: Relevant licences and competent bodies, or confirmed non-applicability
